summary: Flat kerb at north end of quiet Gordon Terrace, homes 15 m away on both sides.
reasons: Quiet residential street, no parking convention

best_section.where: North end of Gordon Terrace, west kerb just below the side-street junction

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 15-19 m away on the west side and across the road; tree cover beside the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with grass verge beside the lane; room to pull off looks adequate.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street; a junction just north.
drivers.convention: One or two cars parked nearby but no camping sign; no marked parking.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Street trees partly shade the west kerb; afternoon sun from the west blocked by gardens.
